```{r}
#| label: faces-cor
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2
#| layout-ncol: 1
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# load(here::here("data", type, "dcounts.rds")) 
# dcounts$perYear |> sum()

readcordata <- function(type) {
  load(
    here::here("data", as.character(type), "dcounts.rds")
  )

  dcounts |>
    group_by(agency) |>
    summarise(
      perYear = sum(perYear, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    rename(!!as.character(type) := perYear)
}

result <- c(1:5,"total") |>
  map(readcordata) |>
  reduce(
    full_join,
    by = c("agency")
  )

d <- result
# googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18pKz-pPVvSlLs92BfVqEvqI2wsLWL3eU6ztmCVPq6bk/edit?gid=0#gid=0") |> write_csv(file = here::here("data", "two-faces.csv") )

# two faces 
tf <- here::here("data", "two-faces.csv") |>  read_csv() |> 
  select(department_agency_acronym, means,	ends) |> 
  mutate(faces= str_c(means, ends) |> 
           str_replace("firstfirst", "First face (both)")  |> 
           str_replace("secondsecond", "Second face (both)")  |> 
           str_replace("neithermixed|mixedneither|neitherneither|mixedmixed|secondfirst|firstsecond", "Nither or mixed")  |> 
           str_replace("first(n|m).*|firstsecond", "first face (means)")  |> 
           str_replace("second(n|m).*", "Second face (means)")  |> 
           str_replace(".*(er|ed)first", "First face (ends)") |> 
           str_replace(".*(er|ed)second", "Second face (ends)"),
         face = ifelse(faces %in% c("First face (both)", "Second face (both)"),
                       faces |> str_remove(" \\(.*"),
                       "Mixed or neither")
         
         ) |> mutate(
  # RENAME TO MATCH
  # (THIS REALLY SHOULD HAVE BEEN STANDARDIZED IN THE SCRIPT THAT CREATED THESE DATA)
  department_agency_acronym = department_agency_acronym |>
    str_replace("HHS_", "DHHS_") |>
    str_replace("HHS$", "DHHS") |>
    str_replace("DHSICE", "DHS_ICE")
)

tf_keys <- unique(tf$department_agency_acronym)

result_joined <- result |>
  mutate(
    department = sub("_.*$", "", agency),
    join_key = case_when(
      agency %in% tf_keys ~ agency,
      department %in% tf_keys ~ department,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    tf,
    by = c("join_key" = "department_agency_acronym")
  ) |>
  select(-department, -join_key)



d <- result_joined |> 
  group_by(face) |>
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -face,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    TYPE = variable,
    Type = case_when(
    TYPE %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "Constituency\nService", 
    TYPE %in% c(4,5) ~ "Policy"), 
         type = case_when(
            TYPE == 1 ~ " Constituent (individual)",
            TYPE == 2 ~ "Constituent (business)",
            TYPE == 3 ~ "Constituent (501c3 or\nlocal government)",
            TYPE == 4 ~ "Policy (business interest)",
            TYPE == 5 ~ "Policy (public interest)",
            TYPE == "total" ~ "Total"
         )) 


d |> 
  drop_na(Type) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value/1000,
      y = "",
      fill = face
      ) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Average Congressional Requests per Year, 2007-2024 (Thousands)",
       y = "",
       fill = "") + 
scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) + 
  theme(palette.fill.discrete = c(#"#E69F00",  
                                    "#D55E00",
                                    #"#F0E442", 
                                    "#999999", 
                                    "#0072B2" ),
        legend.position = c(.9,.26)) +
  facet_wrap("type", scales = "free") + 
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
    color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  )


ggsave(height = 2,
       width = 7,
       filename =here::here("figs", "faces-cor.png"))


```
